subject: Shadow host swap: prepare dry run before marketplace listing
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-07T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Shadow host swap + dry run proposal for Acme marketplace listing

Team —

Quick background: Acme wants us live on the AWS marketplace listing pilot on May 4. The SI (CloudWave) has offered to host a shadow environment for the customer-facing demo week so we can avoid the last-minute infra flip and keep latency predictable.

Ask: can we transfer the shadow-host ownership for the dry run and final rehearsal to CloudWave for the 1-hour customer-facing run on April 21 (US Pacific friendly)? I need the following:
- Updated dry-run runbook (who owns failover, KV cache priming steps, and rollback anchor)
- A short agenda we can share with Acme (10/30/20 minute sections)
- Confirmed contact from infra (owner on-call)

I've attached the current runbook draft and an agenda stub. If we make the swap, CloudWave will handle the ephemeral sandbox networking and we'll keep our dedicated runtime pinned for the production cutover.

Priority: high — marketplace listing date is locked.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Partner GTM | Redwood Inference

Attachments: runbook-dryrun-v2.pdf (pdf, 82KB), demo-agenda-CloudWave.pptx (pptx, 420KB)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-07T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Shadow host swap + dry run proposal for Acme marketplace listing

Sounds reasonable — long-term we want Redwood handling production but I agree having CloudWave host the dry run reduces risk. A couple of quick notes from an ops perspective:
- Jordan: can you confirm the KV cache priming cadence if CloudWave is initiating the cold start? We need a priming script and a token rotation window documented.
- Irene: can you add an entry in the runbook for the Marketplace listing owner (aws-marketplace@redwood.com) and the fallback to our Dedicated pool?

I updated the agenda slides with a tentative 30/20/10 split (intro/technical deep dive/customer Q&A). See comments on slide 2.

Vanessa
Director, Partner Ops | Redwood Inference

Attachment: demo-agenda-CloudWave_v2.pptx (pptx, 435KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-07T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Shadow host swap + dry run proposal for Acme marketplace listing

SGTM. Technical checklist I put in the runbook comments — copying the key bits inline:
1) KV cache priming: run curl script against /prime endpoint (attached) 15 minutes prior to start; keep warm window 30 minutes.
2) Token rotation: CloudWave will use a scoped read-only key for the dry run; our primary tokens must be rotated 1 hour after the demo.
3) Rollback anchor: point DNS back to redwood-dedicated-01 if CloudWave healthcheck fails > 2 attempts.

I can own the priming script and will upload to the Drive link Priya shared. I also recommend a 30-minute partner-only dress rehearsal the day before (April 20) to validate networking and artifacts.

Jordan Blake
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachment: kv-prime.sh (script stub)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Emily Stone <emily.stone@acmecorp.com>, CloudWave SI <partner@cloudwave.io>, AWS Marketplace Onboarding <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-08T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Request: confirm shadow-host swap + dry run timing (Acme / AWS marketplace)

Emily / CloudWave team / AWS team —

Following internal alignment, we'd like to request CloudWave host the April 21 dry run (60 minutes) and a partner-only dress rehearsal on April 20 (30 minutes). Proposed times (US Pacific):
- Dress rehearsal: April 20, 09:00–09:30 PT
- Customer dry run: April 21, 09:00–10:00 PT

CloudWave, please confirm you can provision a shadow sandbox and accept a read-only scoped key for the session. Jordan will prime the KV cache 15 minutes before start and will be on the call for runbook handoff. Vanessa and Irene are on backup ops.

Emily — let us know if those windows work for Acme. If APAC participants need an alternate slot, flag availability and we'll try to accommodate.

Thanks — Priya

Attachments: runbook-dryrun-v2.pdf

Hi Priya / Emily / team —

We can host the shadow sandbox and accept a scoped key. Thank you for the detailed runbook — we've reviewed and proposed two small edits (networking CIDR for the ephemeral VPC and a slightly longer warm window of 45 minutes for the cache). Those edits are in the Drive doc (link below).

One ask: several of our engineers are APAC-based and the proposed 09:00 PT slot is late evening for them. Would you consider shifting the customer dry run to 11:00 PT on April 21? That still meets Acme's requirement and gives our APAC engineers coverage. If 11:00 PT doesn't work for Acme, we can proceed as-is but request an on-call rotation.

We confirm dress rehearsal April 20 at 09:00 PT is fine.

Thanks,
Kavya Rao
CloudWave Solutions — Partner Ops
partner@cloudwave.io
